verdict.rationale: FreshBooks has no documented in-product rule builder. It does document webhooks that fire on events such as invoice.create, with verification and HMAC signing, so users can build their own event-driven actions in external code, though delivery timing is not guaranteed. Built-in automation is limited to fixed workflows like automated bank reconciliation and Bill Pay executing scheduled payments, not user-defined rules. Missing for 10: native user-configurable trigger/condition/action rules, a no-code automation builder, documented examples of rule-driven actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
